_about: Web hosts Rumour Shield recognises as official. Recognising a host only means the website belongs to a government body or its official agency; it never makes a claim in a message true (claims are checked against the documents separately). Match rules: 'suffix' entries match the domain itself and its subdomains at a dot boundary; 'exact' entries match only that host unless subdomains is true. Add a host only after checking who runs it, and record the date.
